title: Time Dilation and center of Mass Normalization in the Page-Wootters Formalism
summary: In this work, we study the emergence of relativistic effects in a composite quantum clock within the Page-Wootters relational formulation of quantum mechanics. We consider a system with internal and center-of-mass degrees of freedom and analyze the conditioned evolution of the center-of-mass relative to the internal system treated as an internal clock. We show that the internal sector exhibits an effective time dilation.
